plannedBy: @aiox-master after PM/architect and independent QA critique

phases.name: TDD locale/catalog contracts
phases.goal: Execute Red→Green→Refactor for independent locale/catalog foundations: PostgreSQL-authoritative locale projection, cross-runtime UTF-8 TSV parser, safe localized messages, and catalog validation.
phases.gate: Each behavior starts with a failing contract/regression test. The approved authored-text, root-collision, and tool-naming decisions no longer block independent foundations; their dependent behaviors still require their own TDD coverage.

phases.name: Catalog and locale foundation
phases.goal: Introduce shared pt-BR/en/es module catalogs, a narrow translation helper, locale validation and explicit native Intl formatting using test-first increments.
verification: unsafe markup and unknown-locale fallback tests

phases.name: Persisted locale and setup/panel surfaces
phases.goal: Seed only a new installation, preserve saved locale through restart/update, and allow protected audited panel changes without process restart.

phases.name: Chat roots, commands and responses
phases.goal: Use only the active locale root !fila, !queue or !cola; localize product replies/help; detect any legacy slug/alias collision and block conflicting-root activation without automatic rename until the owner-approved upgrade resolution is complete.

phases.name: OBS and product-owned widget copy
phases.goal: Localize OBS product-owned widget labels and fallback copy; preserve streamer-authored widget text.
verification: locale switch with an active OBS projection

phases.name: Host install/update/uninstall tools
phases.goal: Localize messages in the unified installer per OS, including install/start, update, and uninstall actions; OPS-5 owns the completed cross-platform packaging.
verification: Linux shell, Windows batch/PowerShell, and macOS shell contract tests where supported
dependency detection and no silent elevation
offline locale bridge and typed delete confirmation

phases.name: Community workflow and quality gates
phases.goal: Publish module/locale templates and contribution guide, automate catalog checks, complete bilingual docs/changelogs, run full quality and platform acceptance, and obtain independent QA.

workflowNotes: Every behavior increment follows Red/Green/Refactor; documentation or planning records must not claim tests that were not run.
Use real PostgreSQL migrations when persistence/transaction behavior is asserted; do not substitute Prisma mocks.
Keep translation tools local; no hosted service or generated translations are assumed.
Update bilingual docs and concise user-facing/internal changelogs within the same release PR.

versioning.planningChange: documentation-only PATCH, current alpha stage retained

nextSteps: Continue remaining localization work and keep operator documentation aligned with the OPS-5 unified installer.
Use Red→Green→Refactor and record exact evidence in the bilingual story log.
Run independent QA and platform validations where applicable.
